statement: Crusoe raised a $3 billion round at a $30 billion valuation, roughly tripling from the more than $10 billion valuation set about ten months earlier.
why: Equity is flowing to GPU data center builders at sharply higher marks, which is the financing condition that lets neoclouds keep placing large accelerator orders.

impact.mechanism: Fresh equity at a higher valuation funds new data center builds and GPU purchases, sustaining marginal-buyer demand for merchant accelerators.

evidence.excerpt: Crusoe, which counts Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI as its customers, has raised a new $3 billion round at a $30 billion valuation.

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet reporting a private round; no filing or company confirmation in the document.
